An article detailing the original problem: http://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/03/us/politics/hillary-clintons-use-of-private-email-at-state-department-raises-flags.html?_r=0

Summary of the original problem: While serving as US Secretary of State, Hillary Clinton used a private email to conduct federal business. Note that this was the norm as early as 2005 (during Colin Powell's tenure as Secretary of State). However, in October 2014, the State department asked that all previous officials holding the position of Secretary of State (dating back to Madeleine K. Albright) provide email records from their private email servers. Clinton's aides did not preserve her personal emails on department servers, as required by the Federal Records Act. Also note that if these emails were part of the official government record, they could be accessed by congressional committees, historians and members of the news media, thus increasing transparency.

Clinton cooperates with the FBI: http://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/top-secret-e-mails-were-sent-on-clintons-private-account-official-says/2015/08/11/f3117f08-403d-11e5-9561-4b3dc93e3b9a_story.html?tid=HP_more?tid=HP_more

Clinton/FBI summary: Clinton did in fact provide her private emails to the FBI when probed. She provided the FBI with over 32,000 emails from her private server. However, she (or, more likely, her staff) first screened the emails, deleting some 32,000 emails without further external review.

An op/ed on the crimes committed by Hillary Clinton, for more detail: http://observer.com/2015/08/the-countless-crimes-of-hillary-clinton-special-prosecutor-needed-now/
